title: Marketing Intern
description:
Job Title: Marketing Intern
 



 Location: Kalyan West
 



 Duration: 3\-6 months
 



  





 About Bilivin Education:
 



  





 Bilivin Education is a fast\-growing EdTech company committed to transforming learning experiences. We provide innovative solutions to empower students and professionals alike. Join us to gain hands\-on experience in the dynamic world of marketing and make a real impact.
 



  





 Job Summary:
 



  





 We are looking for an enthusiastic Marketing Intern to support our marketing team. The intern will assist in qualify, and nurture potential leads for our educational programs. The selected candidate will be responsible for driving student enrollments by connecting with prospects, building trust, and working closely with the sales/admissions team. This role offers exposure to real\-world marketing activities and the opportunity to earn an internship recommendation letter and PPO based on performance.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 \- Research and identify potential students through online and offline channels.
 



 \- Generate, qualify, and manage leads via calls, emails, and social media outreach.
 



 \- Maintain and update the CRM with accurate lead and follow\-up details.
 



 \- Collaborate with the admissions team to convert qualified leads into enrollments.
 



 \- Develop strategies to increase lead volume and enhance conversion rates.
 



 \- Ensure timely follow\-up with prospects to build strong relationships.
 



 \- Prepare reports on lead generation activities and outcomes.
 



  





 Eligibility:
 



  




* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Business, Communication, or related fields.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, basic design tools (Canva, Photoshop), and MS Office.
* Creative, proactive, and eager to learn.



  





 Perks \& Benefits:
 



  




* Hands\-on experience with real marketing projects.
* Internship recommendation letter.
* Potential Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.
* Certificate of Internship upon successful completion.



  





 What We Offer:
 



  





 • Competitive fixed salary
 



 • Attractive monthly performance incentives
 



 • High earning potential for top performers
 



 • Structured training and mentorship programs
 



 • Fast\-track career growth opportunities into Team Leader and managerial roles
 



 • Dynamic, energetic, and supportive work environment 
 



 • Opportunity to work with leading universities and premium education 
 



 programs
 



  





 How to Apply:Interested candidates can apply 📩 Send your updated resume to hr@bilivineducation.com

title: Manager/Dy Manager, Data Center
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
 As our manager – Business Development, Data Centers (India), you'll play a key role in accelerating Danfoss' growth in one of India's fastest\-growing industries. You will help shape the future of sustainable and energy\-efficient data center infrastructure by driving market development, building strategic customer relationships, and influencing the adoption of advanced cooling technologies.
   

  

 Your impact? You'll create new business opportunities, strengthen Danfoss' position with hyperscalers, colocation providers, consultants, and OEMs, and help customers improve energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability. Your work will directly contribute to Danfoss' ambition of becoming a preferred technology partner in India's rapidly evolving data center market.
   

  

 You will collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and Global Data Center teams while taking ownership of key customer engagements, business development initiatives, and ecosystem partnerships that support long\-term growth
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Lead business development activities to identify, qualify, and convert strategic Data Center opportunities across India.
* Build and strengthen relationships with hyperscalers, colocation operators, consultants, EPCs, OEMs, and key industry stakeholders.
* Influence project specifications and cooling architecture decisions by positioning Danfoss' energy\-efficient and sustainable solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop customer value propositions, drive solution selling, and support major project pursuits.
* Represent Danfoss at industry forums, technical seminars, customer events, and industry associations to enhance market visibility and thought leadership.


**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Sales within Data Centers, HVAC\&R, Cooling Solutions, Critical Infrastructure, or Industrial markets.
* Strong understanding of the Data Center ecosystem, including hyperscalers, colocation providers, consultants, and cooling technologies.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build long\-term strategic relationships across multiple levels of customer organizations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and collaboration skills with a proactive and growth\-oriented mindset.


**What You'll Get From Us**
* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. Your well\-being matters to us.
* We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
* You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.


**Ready to Make a Difference?**
 If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Transparency**
 Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.
   

  

 The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.
   

  

 Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
**Job Summary:** 




  





 We are looking for a digital\-first CMO who will lead online client acquisition, digital brand
 



 building, and data\-driven growth for our Wealth Management business. The role focuses
 



 heavily on performance marketing, digital funnels, automation, analytics, and online
 



 investor engagement, with the goal of scaling AUM through digital channels.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Digital Acquisition \& Performance Marketing** 




  





 • Lead end\-to\-end digital acquisition across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn,
 



 programmatic, affiliates, and performance campaigns.
 



 • Drive measurable growth in HNI/UHNI leads, online conversions, and AUM through
 



 digital strategies.
 



 • Optimize CAC, LTV, ROAS, CPL, and full\-funnel conversion metrics.
 



 • Run A/B testing, landing page experiments, and CRO to improve digital performance.
 



  





**Digital Strategy \& Martech** 




  





 • Build a long\-term digital growth roadmap, including SEO, automation, funnels, and
 



 digital content engines.
 



 • Implement and manage CRM \& marketing automation tools (HubSpot, WebEngage,
 



 LeadSquared, etc.).
 



 • Leverage analytics, dashboards, and data modeling for decision\-making and
 



 forecasting.
 



  





**Digital Brand, Content \& Communication** 




  





 • Strengthen the company’s digital brand identity across all online channels.
 



 • Lead digital PR, influencer marketing (finance creators), and thought\-leadership
 



 campaigns.
 



 • Oversee content on wealth products: PMS, AIF, MF, Bonds, etc.
 



 • Ensure SEBI\-compliant communication across all digital assets.
 



  





**Client Engagement \& Retention (Digital CX)** 




  





 • Build personalized, automated communication journeys based on client profiles and
 



 behaviors.
 



 • Improve digital engagement via newsletters, webinars, market updates, and advisory
 



 insights.
 



 • Develop digital touchpoints that enhance investor experience and loyalty.
 



  





**Leadership \& Collaboration** 




  





 • Lead teams in digital marketing, growth, content, design, and analytics.
 



 • Work closely with advisory, research, sales, and compliance teams.
 



 • Set digital KPIs and drive accountability for growth outcomes.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  





 • 10\+ years in digital marketing, preferably within Wealth Management / BFSI.
 



 • Strong expertise in performance marketing, digital funnels, SEO/SEM, and online
 



 acquisition.
 



 • Deep understanding of wealth products (PMS, AIF, MF, Bonds).
 



 • Hands\-on experience with CRM, automation, analytics, and MarTech tools.
 



 • Strong analytical mindset with proven digital growth achievements.

title: Junior Influencer Marketing Executive
description:
**About Capes India:** 




 Capes India is India’s premium tech accessory brand, known for blending functionality with style. From sleek phone, laptop, and camera skins to innovative MagLock wallets and car mounts, we’re redefining how gadgets express personality. We don’t just make accessories we build an aesthetic.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 As our Influencer Marketing Executive, you’ll help connect Capes India with creators who align with our visual identity and brand voice. If you’re passionate about social media trends, influencer culture, and the intersection of tech and style, this role is for you.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Identify and onboard influencers across tech, fashion, lifestyle, automotive, and related niches
* Craft compelling outreach messages and manage influencer communications
* Oversee collaborations, including product dispatch, content tracking, and performance analysis
* Maintain and update a database of micro and macro influencers
* Analyse content and campaign performance to derive actionable insights
* Collaborate with creators on content ideas that reflect Capes India’s tone and values
* Monitor social media trends to scout emerging talent and formats
* Coordinate internally for timely approvals and logistics



  





**Requirements:** 



* Strong grasp of influencer marketing and Instagram trends
* Passion for tech, gadgets, and aesthetic\-driven brands
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable with Google Sheets and basic project tracking tools
* Creative thinker with strong attention to detail



 Bonus: Experience working with influencers or managing brand collaborations

title: Product Line Specialist
description:
Requisition Number: 77922
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 Corning’s Businesses Are Ever\-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
   

  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions


 Purpose of Position
   

  

* Develops and executes a product line strategy that supports the achievement of desired product line sales growth and profitability


 Major Responsibility
   

  

 Works Closely With, Or Leads, a Cross\-functional Product Team Consisting Of Functional Leads From Development, Product Engineering, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Marketing And/or Sales To
   

  

* Develop the product or product line’s market value proposition and pricing strategy.
* Develop and execute the product line planning process, including the identification of critical projects to be undertaken for the year.
* Find the optimal solution (balancing the needs of Corning and the customer) to all product issues related to performance (i.e., specs, attributes, services), quality, share growth, customer needs (contract management)
* Create an intellectual property and standards strategy for the product line.
* Understand downstream market requirements and assess competitive threats and implications for the business.
* Create long\-term forecasting plans.
* Works with Program Management or New Business Development to ‘receive’ new products, as appropriate.
* Develops a compelling market value proposition that differentiates Corning’s products and services in the marketplace.
* Develops the product line strategy and manages the product line through the stages of innovation, from product concept through commercialization and life\-cycle management, as appropriate depending on the stage of handoff from Program Management or New Business Development
* May manage a portfolio of markets, in the case where the product line’s products hold different positions within the markets they reach.
* Identifies the best mix for the market(s) through effective segmentation and portfolio rationalization.
* Optimizes inventory management related to the product line by coordinating information flow, as needed, between Forecasting, Sales, Manufacturing, and other parties as needed.
* May get involved in supply chain disruption issues to influence or make decisions on global order and Development/Manufacturing prioritization.
* Works with Manufacturing and Sales to identify opportunities to reduce complexity and cost reduction in the manufacturing process both at Corning’s plant(s) and the customer site, as appropriate.
* Works with the Standards group to set and drive the standards strategy for the product line.
* Addresses new product/special requests by developing a business case (including P\&L and balance sheet implications) to determine the feasibility and pricing requirements of the requests.
* Owns and optimizes, or may work with the Pricing Manger to optimize, pricing levels by setting floor price, establishing pricing structure, optimizing product premiums, and ensuring value received for product line
* Works with Account Management to develop value propositions that improve margins for Corning’s products and services and enable new/enhanced selling opportunities with customers.
* Manages the obsolescence process, as necessary, to extract maximum value through the end of the product’s lifecycle.
* May oversee, develop, and direct a Product Line team.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree \- Technical (engineering degree or other formal engineering education)
* MBA desired
* Intermediate Project Management Skills and Practices
* Product / Process Knowledge
* Customer Knowledge


**Required Competency (Skills, Knowledge And Abilities)**
* Demonstrated track record of managing projects.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and/or actively participating in multi\-functional teams.
* Fluent English written and spoken. Knowledge of additional Asian language knowledge is a plus.
* Good knowledge of Excel spreadsheets and MS Office in general
* Optical Industry Acumen is a plus.
* Technology around the Data Center including cabling and actives/networking are a plus.

title: Ecommerce Business Manager
description:
Role Overview
 
  





 We are looking for a
 **E\-Commerce Business manager** 
 to own the end\-to\-end e\-commerce business across the company’s
 **own digital platform and third\-party marketplaces** 
 .
 



 The role will combine
 **e\-commerce operations, P\&L ownership, business growth, marketplace management, inventory and supply chain coordination, customer experience, and cross\-functional leadership** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should understand the complete e\-commerce ecosystem — from product listing and inventory availability to order processing, fulfilment, customer experience, marketplace performance, profitability, and business growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience managing ecommerce platforms (e.g., marketplaces or branded online stores), including catalog management and order processing.
* Skills in sales analysis, data\-driven decision\-making, and reporting on ecommerce performance metrics.
* Ability to coordinate with marketing teams on digital campaigns, promotions, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Strong organizational and operational skills for inventory tracking, vendor coordination, and logistics oversight.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team collaboration abilities.
* Proven experience in ecommerce, retail, or business management; prior leadership or P\&L responsibility is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; advanced certifications in ecommerce or digital business are a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
